governance_checks.statement: The retrieved coordination snapshot is the model-set tip.
governance_checks.note: For MODEL_SET_1 in PROJECT_1, get_model_set identified MODEL_SET_VERSION_1 as the tip and list_model_set_versions independently confirmed it as the highest successful version; get_model_set_version then retrieved that exact snapshot.

governance_checks.statement: Each participating document exposes an exact coordinated version.
governance_checks.note: MODEL_SET_VERSION_1 contained exactly two participating documents; each returned a stable lineage reference and an exact coordinated version reference (VERSION_1, VERSION_2).

governance_checks.statement: Discipline is not inferred when no authoritative field is returned.
governance_checks.note: No authoritative discipline field was returned for either participant; discipline was left null and never inferred from filenames, display names, folders, model titles, or viewer context.

governance_checks.statement: No numeric Data Management document version is inferred from a URN.
governance_checks.note: version_number is null for both participants; MODEL_SET_VERSION_1 is a coordination snapshot version and is not a Data Management document version.

governance_checks.statement: The issue's typed placement lineage matches a snapshot participant.
governance_checks.note: ISSUE_1's typed placement-lineage reference exactly matched MODEL_1's participating lineage in MODEL_SET_VERSION_1 (a typed issue-field match).

governance_checks.statement: Viewer-state-derived version references match the participants.
governance_checks.note: Two distinct issue-side version references decoded from viewer state exactly matched VERSION_1 and VERSION_2 in MODEL_SET_VERSION_1; contextual model matching only.

governance_checks.statement: Viewer-state element isolation is not clash membership.
governance_checks.note: The viewer-state content was treated as contextual model/version evidence only and was never interpreted as clash membership or clash provenance.

governance_checks.statement: A UI clash association is contextual evidence only.
governance_checks.note: The Forma UI Clashes tab showed one clash under the issue, but this is contextual UI evidence only; the API exposed no machine-readable clash identifier, group, member, or origin.

governance_checks.statement: Issue status is not treated as geometric resolution.
governance_checks.note: The issue is open; issue status alone was not used to claim or deny geometric resolution.

governance_checks.statement: The Relationships API returned no matching record.
governance_checks.note: list_issue_relationships returned zero records for ISSUE_1. This proves only that no matching Relationships API record was returned; it does not prove the real-world issue is unrelated.

governance_checks.statement: A typed issue-to-model-set or issue-to-snapshot relationship exists.
governance_checks.note: No typed relationship linking ISSUE_1 to MODEL_SET_1 or MODEL_SET_VERSION_1 was returned; the shared-model-context evidence is a typed issue-field and viewer-state match, not a typed relationship.

governance_checks.statement: A direct clash-to-issue relationship is proven.
governance_checks.note: No clash identifier, clash-group identifier, clash-member collection, or clash-origin field was returned, so no direct clash-to-issue provenance could be established.

governance_checks.statement: Clash membership is exposed by the API.
governance_checks.note: The component exposes no clash-member reads; clash membership was neither returned nor inferred.

governance_checks.statement: Geometric resolution of a clash is verified.
governance_checks.note: No later coordinated version was compared and no clash recheck was performed; geometric resolution was not verified.

warnings.message: get_latest_model_set_version returned a transport timeout and produced no evidence. The latest snapshot was instead established because get_model_set identified the tip, list_model_set_versions independently confirmed it as the highest successful version, and get_model_set_version successfully retrieved that exact snapshot and its two participating documents. The timeout is a disclosed tool limitation and does not invalidate the retrieved snapshot evidence.

list_issue_relationships returned no records for ISSUE_1. This verifies the lookup capability but proves only that no matching Relationships API record was returned; it does not prove the issue is unrelated in the project or the Autodesk UI.

Exact coordinated document-version references are not typed issue fields. The two version references were decoded from a viewer-state field already returned by a read-only tool and matched against the retrieved snapshot participants.
Viewer-state element isolation is contextual model/version evidence only and is not clash membership.

The Forma UI associated ISSUE_1 with one clash, but the API returned no clash identifier, clash-group identifier, clash-member collection, or clash-origin field; the UI association is contextual only and not machine-readable provenance.
No direct clash-to-issue relationship was provable from the available reads; a shared model context is not a clash-to-issue link.
The issue remains open and no later coordinated version or clash recheck was evaluated; geometric resolution was not verified.
